name: Autumn Falls
description: A small Vermont town where three generations of a family gather for a wedding that will change everything.
seed_prompt: A family drama set during a pivotal weekend where old wounds surface and new bonds form.
lore_content:
Autumn Falls, Vermont. Population 3,200. The kind of place where everyone knows your business but pretends they don't. The Callahan family has lived here for five generations, and this weekend, they're all coming home for a wedding.

Eleanor Callahan, 78, is the family matriarch. Sharp-tongued and sharper-minded, she's kept this family together through sheer force of will. She's hiding a diagnosis she hasn't shared with anyone. This might be the last time she sees all her children in one place.

Michael Callahan, 52, is Eleanor's eldest. A successful Boston lawyer, he hasn't spoken to his brother David in fifteen years over their father's will. His wife Patricia thinks this trip is a mistake. His daughter Emma, the bride, just wants one weekend without drama.

David Callahan, 48, stayed in Autumn Falls to run the family hardware store. He's quietly bitter about being the one who stayed while Michael got the glory. His wife Sarah knows he's been drinking again. Their son Jake, 19, is thinking about dropping out of college.

Margaret 'Maggie' Callahan, 45, is the youngest sibling. A free spirit who left for California at 18 and never looked back. She's returning with her partner Alex, whom the family has never met. She's also three months pregnant and hasn't told anyone.

Emma Callahan, 26, is getting married to Ryan Torres, a kind man from a working-class family. She loves him, but part of her wonders if she's settling. Her college ex, James, just RSVP'd yes to the wedding.

Ryan Torres, 28, knows the Callahans think he's not good enough for Emma. He's determined to prove himself, but the prenup Michael insisted on still stings.

Reverend Thomas Chen has known this family for thirty years. He's seen their best and worst. He's also the only person who knows Eleanor's secret, bound by a confession she made last month.

Over one weekend, secrets will surface, old wounds will reopen, and this family will either heal or shatter.

origins.name: Townie
origins.description: Rooted in Autumn Falls, you know everyone's secrets, and they know yours.
traits: Local Knowledge: Advantage on History checks related to Autumn Falls.

origins.name: Out-of-Stater
origins.description: New to Autumn Falls or returning after a long absence, you see the town with fresh eyes.
traits: Keen Observer: Advantage on Perception checks to notice small details.

origins.name: Callahan Blood
origins.description: Born into the Callahan family, you carry the weight of their legacy and expectations.
traits: Callahan Resilience: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

origins.name: Working Class
origins.description: You come from a background of hard work and practical skills, often feeling like an outsider among the Callahans.
traits: Practical Knowledge: Proficient in one tool of your choice.

archetypes.name: Fixer
archetypes.description: Skilled at resolving conflicts and keeping the peace, often through negotiation or subtle manipulation.

features.name: Calming Presence
features.description: As an action, you can attempt to calm a creature within 30 feet of you. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus) or be charmed by you until the end of your next turn.

archetypes.name: Skeptic
archetypes.description: A keen observer with a knack for uncovering secrets and questioning everything.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack’s damage against you.

archetypes.name: Caretaker
archetypes.description: Compassionate and dedicated to helping others, often carrying the burdens of those around them.

features.name: Soothing Touch
features.description: As an action, you can touch one willing creature and restore a number of hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your level. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one).

archetypes.name: Enforcer
archetypes.description: Used to getting their way through intimidation or force, often protecting those they care about.

features.name: Imposing Presence
features.description: You have advantage on Intimidation checks against creatures smaller than you.

setting_skills.name: Small Town Gossip
setting_skills.description: Ability to find out the latest happenings and rumors in Autumn Falls.

setting_skills.name: Family History
setting_skills.description: Knowledge of the Callahan family and their past.

setting_skills.name: Reading People
setting_skills.description: Ability to gauge someone's emotional state or honesty.

world_descriptors.architecture: New England clapboard houses, family homesteads with wraparound porches, intimate interiors heavy with memory and unspoken tension
world_descriptors.landscape: Vermont autumn, covered bridges, small town main streets, cemeteries where generations rest
world_descriptors.vegetation: Maple trees in full color, overgrown gardens, untended family plots, seasonal decay
world_descriptors.weather: Crisp autumn air, morning fog over the valley, rain on wedding days, clear skies that feel earned
world_descriptors.people: Weathered faces carrying decades of history, body language that speaks louder than words, eyes that avoid or confront
world_descriptors.clothing: Sunday best and comfortable old sweaters, wedding attire that reveals character, layers against the cold
world_descriptors.technology: Landline phones, kitchen appliances from different decades, cars that have seen the family through
world_descriptors.lighting: Golden hour through lace curtains, kitchen light at midnight conversations, candles at the rehearsal dinner

visual_identity.visual_exclusions: Action sequences, supernatural elements, bright cheerful tones without underlying tension
